about.title: About
about.p1: Trillion AI Tech is an independent technology studio based in Aotearoa New Zealand.
about.p2: We build applications, games, AI agent systems, tools, and software with a focus on innovation, usability, and modern design principles.
about.p3: Our mission is to create technology that empowers users and enhances their digital experiences. We believe in transparent development, ethical AI practices, and building products that genuinely solve problems.
about.notice: In development · Building the future, one product at a time.
